units.source_text: 将近破晓，诸人均已酣眠，源氏公子亦稍稍入睡。

en.t: Toward dawn, everyone had fallen fast asleep, and Prince Genji too drifted briefly into sleep.

units.source_text: 梦见一个素不相识的人，走进室内，叫道：“刚才大王召唤，为何不到？”

en.t: He dreamed that a complete stranger came into the room and cried, "The great king summoned you just now. Why have you not come?"

units.source_text: 便向各处寻找源氏公子。

en.t: Then the stranger began searching everywhere for Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 公子惊醒，想道：“听说海龙王最爱美貌之人，想是看中我了。”

en.t: The prince woke with a start and thought, "I have heard that the Sea Dragon King is especially fond of beautiful people. He must have taken a fancy to me."

units.source_text: 这就使得他更加恐惧，觉得这海边越发不堪久居了。

en.t: This made him still more afraid, and he felt more than ever that he could not remain long by this shore.
